title: Driver Daily Route Checklist
subtitle: Driver Daily Route: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Driver Daily Route Checklist covers driver, vehicle, stop sequence, shipment, time window, mileage, and route exception. The route dispatch coordinator records Driver Daily Route criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Driver Daily Route Checklist keeps Driver Daily Route exceptions visible until the route dispatch coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Driver Daily Route Checklist at dispatch point, planned route, customer stops, safe parking, and return yard. Document driver, vehicle, stop sequence, shipment, time window, mileage, and route exception identity before Driver Daily Route begins. Compare driver, vehicle, stop sequence, shipment, time window, mileage, and route exception findings with stated Driver Daily Route criteria; route unresolved Driver Daily Route issues to transport operations reviewer. For Driver Daily Route Checklist, confirm requirements for Driver Daily Route. Ask transport operations reviewer to review Driver Daily Route conditions beyond the route dispatch coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Driver Daily Route, identify responsible parties, dispatch point, planned route, customer stops, safe parking, and return yard, and the linked driver, vehicle, stop sequence, shipment, time window, mileage, and route exception source.

fields.label: Stop, order, piece, and time-window references

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Driver Daily Route facts for driver, vehicle, stop sequence, shipment, time window, mileage, and route exception; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Driver Daily Route inspection checks
items: Departure, arrival, service, and departure times
Delivery, pickup, refusal, and failed-attempt result
Delay, reroute, incident, and return reconciliation

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: Use observed Driver Daily Route evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Route Dispatch Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Hours, weather, road, or fatigue concern
Delay or failed stop lacks accountable routing
Return mileage, pieces, and undelivered inventory
blocks.guidance: Pause Driver Daily Route when driver, vehicle, route safety, cargo custody, or unresolved stop exception prevents controlled continuation. Retain the available Driver Daily Route proof and route unresolved driver, vehicle, stop sequence, shipment, time window, mileage, and route exception scope to route dispatch coordinator.
